app.title: R1999 Translator
toast.engine_failed: Could not start the translation engine
toast.translator_unavailable: Argos has no model for {lang}. Using NLLB-200
startup.text:
R1999 Translator is running.
It stays in the system tray at the bottom right, next to the clock. Right-click its icon there to quit.
In the game, press {menu} for settings and {screenshot} to save a screenshot with the translation.
startup.already: R1999 Translator is already running. Look for its icon in the system tray at the bottom right.
notify.ready: Ready. Press {key} in the game for settings
notify.background_start: Downloading the {name} model in the background ({mb} MB). You can keep playing
notify.background_done: The {name} model is ready. Switching translators is now instant
notify.background_failed: Could not download the {name} model. It will be tried again next time
setup.text:
A translation model must be downloaded once. The small one comes first, the other keeps downloading in the background.
It is stored locally and translation runs offline.
menu.title: Translation settings
menu.hint: ↑ ↓ Select      ← → Change      PgUp PgDn Jump      Enter Confirm      Esc Close
opt.line_space.grow: Move up as lines are added
